//! Writes v0.2 (.lup format version 1) fixtures for the v0.3 migration tests.
//! Run in a v0.2 checkout:
//! PLUM_FIXTURE_DIR=<dir> cargo test -p plumspirit_engine --test make_v03_fixtures -- --ignored

mod common;

use common::*;
use plumspirit_engine::history::{History, Operation};
use plumspirit_engine::midi::{export_to_bytes, import_bytes};
use plumspirit_engine::model::{Bpm, OnionConfig, OnionMode, PlumDocument, SoundFontRef, TrackId};
use plumspirit_engine::native::project_to_bytes;

fn save(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str, doc: &PlumDocument) {
    std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{name}.lup")), project_to_bytes(doc).unwrap()).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{name}.mid")), export_to_bytes(doc).unwrap()).unwrap();
}

fn imported() -> PlumDocument {
    let tr0 = {
        let mut t = TrackBytes::new();
        t.meta(0, 0x03, b"Conductor \xE9")
            .meta(0, 0x51, &[0x07, 0xA1, 0x20]) // 500,000 (shadowed)
            .meta(0, 0x51, &[0x06, 0x1A, 0x80]) // 400,000 (plays)
            .meta(0, 0x58, &[3, 2, 24, 8])
            .meta(0, 0x06, b"Intro")
            .meta(1920, 0x51, &[0x03, 0xD0, 0x90]) // 250,000
            .meta(2880, 0x58, &[7, 3, 24, 8])
            .meta(3000, 0x07, b"Hit");
        t.eot(9000)
    };
    let tr1 = {
        let mut t = TrackBytes::new();
        t.ev(0, &[0xB0, 0x0A, 0x20]) // pan
            .ev(0, &[0xC0, 0x05])
            .on(0, 0, 60, 100)
            .ev(10, &[0xE0, 0x00, 0x50]) // pitch bend
            .off(480, 0, 60, 64)
            .on(480, 9, 36, 127)
            .meta(960, 0x51, &[0x09, 0x27, 0xC0]) // 600,000 in another track
            .off(960, 9, 36, 0)
            .meta(1440, 0x06, b"Drop")
            .on(1440, 1, 72, 1)
            .off(2000, 1, 72, 0);
        t.eot(2400)
    };
    let (mut doc, _) = import_bytes(&smf(1, 480, &[tr0, tr1])).unwrap();
    let p = doc.project_mut();
    p.name = "Imported ✓".into();
    p.onion = OnionConfig {
        mode: OnionMode::Specific,
        specific: vec![TrackId(1)],
        opacity: 35,
    };
    doc
}

#[test]
#[ignore = "writes fixtures"]
fn write_fixtures() {
    let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("PLUM_FIXTURE_DIR").unwrap());
    // A new project: exact decimal project tempo, raw 4/4 time signature.
    let mut doc = PlumDocument::new_project("Legacy ✓".into(), Bpm::parse("150.5").unwrap(), 960);
    doc.track_mut(0)
        .unwrap()
        .notes
        .insert_sorted_batch(&[rec(0, 960, 60), rec(960, 480, 64), rec(1920, 1, 67)], false)
        .unwrap();
    let t = doc.add_track().unwrap();
    doc.track_mut(t)
        .unwrap()
        .notes
        .insert_sorted_batch(&[rec(0, 240, 36), rec(480, 240, 38)], false)
        .unwrap();
    doc.project_mut().soundfont = Some(SoundFontRef {
        path: "C:\\SoundFonts\\GeneralUser GS.sf2".into(),
    });
    save(&dir, "new_project", &doc);
    // An imported file with tempo/meter/markers in two tracks.
    save(&dir, "imported", &imported());
    // …plus a project tempo (v0.2 replaced the tick-0 tempo events on export).
    let mut doc = imported();
    History::default()
        .apply(&mut doc, Operation::SetTempo(Some(Bpm::parse("123.456").unwrap())))
        .unwrap();
    save(&dir, "imported_project_tempo", &doc);
    // Many tracks (with deleted track ids in between), notes on every channel.
    let mut doc = PlumDocument::new_project("Many".into(), Bpm::parse("200").unwrap(), 96);
    for i in 0..70u64 {
        let t = doc.add_track().unwrap();
        let recs: Vec<_> = (0..8u64)
            .map(|k| {
                let mut r = rec(k * 96 + i, 90, (24 + i + k) as u8);
                r.attrs = attrs((24 + i + k) as u8, (1 + i * 3 % 127) as u8, (i % 16) as u8);
                r
            })
            .collect();
        doc.track_mut(t).unwrap().notes.insert_sorted_batch(&recs, false).unwrap();
    }
    for index in [65usize, 40, 3] {
        doc.delete_track(index).unwrap();
    }
    doc.project_mut().onion = OnionConfig {
        mode: OnionMode::AllOthers,
        specific: Vec::new(),
        opacity: 60,
    };
    save(&dir, "many_tracks", &doc);
}
